title: Pinay cyclist finishes 30th in Youth Olympic Games
summary: Filipina cyclist Maritanya Krog wound up in 30th place in the women's road race in the 4th Youth Olympic Games, held under tremendous heat at the Corniche course in Dakar, Senegal on Sunday.
